correctness.rationale: For sign imbalance \(\delta_R\), the exact one-coordinate cumulant generating function expands as \(K_\delta(t)=t^2/2+\sqrt2\,\delta t^3/3+t^4/2+O(t^5)\). Independent series inversion gives \(I_\delta(a)=a^2/2-\sqrt2\,\delta a^3/3+(\delta^2-1/2)a^4+O(a^5)\). On \(x\asymp\sqrt{\log p}\), exponential tilting yields the stated relative-tail exponent, whose substitution gives \(\Theta_p=(4/3)\delta_R L^{3/2}/\sqrt R+(2-4\delta_R^2)L^2/R\). Independence converts this to the shifted-Gumbel law and the explicit Kolmogorov profile. The \(3/4\)-positive versus balanced indefinite example at \(R\asymp L^{5/2}\) then has the claimed opposite limits.
